registry.description: Corruption is the process by which something good decays from the inside — not destroyed from without but rotting from within. The Hebrew and Greek vocabulary covers physical decay (the body returning to dust, the pit) and moral corruption (the inner person becoming rotten, perverted, given over to evil). The body's corruption is one of Paul's key images for what the resurrection reverses. Moral corruption is the steady undoing of the image of God in a person through persistent sin.
